core.title: Bread pickup moved by bakery
core.setting: Food bank coordinator at Bright Harbour Food Bank, serving 500 households weekly

events.text: Standing instruction for the team: if a confirmed volunteer shift is moved to a different day, time or meeting point, the volunteer must agree to the move personally before we treat it as set. Never just update the rota and assume.
Finance policy for Bright Harbour Food Bank: any supplier order over £500 needs sign-off from our finance lead Priya Shah before it is placed. Orders of £500 or less I can place directly.

Hello Mara, confirming our standing surplus arrangement with Bright Harbour Food Bank: 80 trays of bread for collection every Friday at 14:00 from our Dock Road depot. Your driver can ask for the duty baker at the loading bay.
Hi Mara, happy to keep doing the bread run for the food bank. Fridays suit me best, I can do the afternoon pickup every week with the van.

Set up the weekly bread run: Tom Weller collects 80 trays from Harvest Mill Bakery's Dock Road depot every Friday at 14:00 and brings them to the food bank. Confirmed with Tom and entered on the schedule.

Ordered 80 stacking bread crates from PackRight Supplies at £4 each (£320 total) so we can handle the 80 trays coming in each Friday from Harvest Mill Bakery. Under the £500 line so I placed it directly.
Planned the Saturday distribution food parcels around the weekly bread run: 80 bread portions set aside each week from the Friday collection, one per household in the first queue group.
Dear Mara, St Aldhelm's Hall is free on Saturdays between 08:00 and 12:00 through the autumn if Bright Harbour Food Bank wants to run anything here. Kitchen use included.
Booked St Aldhelm's Hall for a community cooking workshop on Saturday 24 October, 09:00 to 11:30, using their Saturday morning slot and kitchen.
Mara, I can drive the Wednesday vegetable run for the food bank every week, mornings or early afternoon both fine.
Assigned Ruth Kwan as the regular driver for the Wednesday vegetable run, collecting from the market gardeners and delivering to the food bank by 15:00.
Quote for Bright Harbour Food Bank: tinned tomatoes at £0.62 per tin for orders of 1,000 tins or more, delivery included to your warehouse.
Ordered 1,100 tins of tomatoes from Harbourside Wholesale at £0.62 per tin (£682). As it is over £500, Priya Shah signed it off before I placed the order.
Hi Mara, we now have 26 volunteers confirmed for the Saturday distributions at the main hall, enough for five packing tables plus the welcome desk.
Set the weekly Saturday distribution at the main hall, 09:00 start, staffed by the 26 confirmed volunteers across five packing tables and the welcome desk.
Hello Mara, we can supply long-grain rice at £8.40 per 10kg sack for the food bank, any quantity up to 60 sacks a month, delivered free.
Ordered 45 sacks of rice from Quay Stores at £8.40 a sack (£378 total). Under £500 so no finance sign-off needed.
Note to self: fridge thermometer checks now happen every morning at 08:30, logged in the kitchen folder.
Dear Ms Mara Ellison, thank you for your community update. The council newsletter will feature Bright Harbour Food Bank in the autumn edition.
To-do: renew the van insurance before 2026-11-30 and file the certificate in the office drawer.
Minutes of the July volunteer meeting: tea rota agreed, two new volunteers welcomed, next meeting in October.
Hi Mara, just confirming everything carries on as usual after the summer: 80 trays of bread for you every Friday at 14:00 from our Dock Road depot. See your driver then.
Dear everyone at Bright Harbour Food Bank, thank you for the parcels this summer. The bread on Saturdays made a real difference to us.
Notice: the warehouse car park on Plover Street will be closed for resurfacing on Saturday 12 September and Sunday 13 September. Please plan deliveries around these dates.
Hello Mara, Saltrock Bakery can offer 60 trays of bread weekly at £1.20 per tray, delivered to your door every Friday morning. Happy to start any week that suits you.
Mara, the van has new tyres as of today, so no worries about the Friday runs in the wet weather.

Hello Mara, a heads-up from Harvest Mill Bakery: we have lost a supermarket contract, so our surplus is smaller and we are consolidating sites. From Friday 9 October your collection will be 40 trays at 11:00 from our Riverside depot instead of Dock Road. Sorry for the short notice and thanks for bearing with us.
Hi Mara, the October volunteer rota is now circulated. All 26 Saturday volunteers have confirmed for this month.
The Harbourside Wholesale tinned tomato delivery arrived in good order; stacked in aisle 2 of the warehouse.
